description: Settled and sold trades, newest first, with realized P&L, instrument_id and a win/loss/void tally. Scope with window ('30d', '90d', 'all' for since Sep 1, 2026), since ('30d', a day YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO time) and until, or run='current' for only what closed since your last reset; omit them for every closed trade. A position written off by a reset shows status sold with close_reason account_reset.

month.description: Deprecated: use since and until. One month, as YYYY-MM.

run.description: current: only trades closed since your last reset.

since.description: Closed on or after: 30d, a day YYYY-MM-DD (New York) or an ISO time.

until.description: Closed before the end of this day YYYY-MM-DD, or an ISO time.

window.description: all (since Sep 1, 2026), 30d or 90d. Default: every closed trade.

name: get_history
title: Closed trades
